status_detail: Chesapeake City Council denied rezoning PLN-REZ-2025-002 on June 17, 2025 after the Planning Commission had recommended denial. The application proposed rezoning about 22.6 acres from A-1 to M-1 for a 349,458 sq ft data center building plus 35,316 sq ft of chillers/generators, total footprint 384,774 sq ft, in the Great Bridge planning area west of Centerville Turnpike and south of Etheridge Manor Boulevard.
notes: Official application packet names applicant/owner and project scope. Official June 2025 minutes record the substitute motion to deny and 7-0 vote. Local reporting identifies Doug Fuller as the developer and says this would have been Hampton Roads' first major data center.

project_name: STACK Infrastructure Berry Hill Megasite data center campus
status_detail: The Danville-Pittsylvania Regional Industrial Facility Authority approved a local performance agreement with STACK Infrastructure in May 2026 for a proposed AI/data center campus at the Southern Virginia Megasite at Berry Hill. Reported terms require at least $73.5 billion investment and 2,050 jobs, with company plans described as about $100 billion over three decades and 2,500 jobs over two decades. The site is owned by the Danville-Pittsylvania RIFA and physically located in Pittsylvania County; City of Danville also adopted a 2026 data center equipment tax-rate ordinance for qualifying facilities of at least 20 MW.
notes: Recorded under Danville city because the city is a RIFA co-owner/participant and approved related tax treatment, but the data-center campus site is in neighboring Pittsylvania County rather than inside the independent city.
